timestamp.description: Timestamp indicating when the activity occurred.

description.description: Description of the activity, such as comments, state change, or value change.

parent.description: The entity that this activity is associated with.

activityType.description: The type of this activity, categorized by {@link ReliabilityActivity}.

updatedBy.description: Name of the user who performed the activity.

files.description: Files attached to this activity (if any).

title:
Type to track activities related to a parent entity (e.g., case, asset, etc.).
Each activity includes a timestamp, description, and associated user information.
name: ReliabilityActivity
